writeup: TIC 394710986 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.6837 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse that dims the system by 1.94%, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 84.6. Pixel-level analysis confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a centroid offset of 2.0 arcsec and a peak signal-to-noise of 21.6. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a potentially novel target. The machine-learning screening score of 0.75 indicates the pipeline's model assesses this as a likely genuine eclipsing binary, and the data passed all quality checks without flags or concerns.
